description: This file defines API routes related to user sessions using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting user sessions, integrating with a Supabase backend for data storage and access control. The file sets up an API router, configures database interactions, and manages user authentication and authorization via dependencies.

methods.name: get_supabase()
methods.description: Creates a Supabase client for session routes, configured with environment variables.

methods.name: list_sessions(request: Request, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Lists all sessions for the current authenticated user.

methods.name: create_session(request: Request, payload: SessionCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new session record owned by the current user.

methods.name: get_session(request: Request, session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Fetches a specific session by ID, ensuring it belongs to the current user.

methods.name: update_session(request: Request, session_id: str, payload: SessionUpdate, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates the title of an existing session if owned by the current user.

methods.name: delete_session(request: Request, session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a session owned by the current user.
